pure-announcement.rationale: Vendor documentation explaining how a policy engine works, not a launch, release note or funding announcement; it teaches a mechanism rather than announcing availability.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts cover MCP governance and platform paving; none covers stateful allow/ask/deny policy interception of agent actions.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The decision semantics and configuration mechanics are primary-source documented behavior a reader can reproduce against the product.

durability.rationale: The transferable insight (session-stateful policies can express budgets, rate limits and risk scores that static allowlists cannot) is durable, but most of the note is Omnigent-specific config syntax, level names and REST endpoints that will churn with the product.

actionability.rationale: Every concrete step (YAML policy blocks, `-c` server config, settings panel) applies only inside Omnigent; a reader building elsewhere gets a design principle to reconstruct, not directly usable guidance.

atomicity.rationale: One core idea, statable in a single paragraph: contextual, stateful policy enforcement over agent actions with allow/ask/deny decisions at layered scopes.
